jobs.title: Climate Data Scientist
jobs.description: Join our team to analyze global climate data and develop predictive models for climate change impacts. You'll work with satellite data, weather station records, and advanced statistical methods to understand climate patterns and trends.
requirements: PhD in Climate Science, Atmospheric Physics, or related field
5+ years experience with climate data analysis
Proficiency in Python, R, and MATLAB
Experience with NetCDF, HDF5, and geospatial data formats
Knowledge of climate models (GCMs, RCMs) and statistical downscaling

jobs.title: Renewable Energy Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Design and optimize renewable energy systems including solar, wind, and battery storage. You'll work on grid integration, energy forecasting, and system performance optimization for utility-scale projects.
requirements: MS in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy, or related field
3+ years experience in renewable energy systems
Knowledge of power systems, grid codes, and energy storage
Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, PVsyst, or WindPRO
Understanding of electrical grid operations and smart grid technologies

jobs.title: Atmospheric Research Scientist
jobs.description: Conduct research on severe weather phenomena, atmospheric dynamics, and weather prediction. You'll analyze observational data, run numerical weather models, and publish findings in peer-reviewed journals.
requirements: PhD in Atmospheric Science, Meteorology, or related field
Experience with numerical weather prediction models
Strong background in atmospheric physics and dynamics
Proficiency in Fortran, Python, and NCL
Experience with radar, satellite, and in-situ observations

jobs.title: GIS Analyst - Environmental Monitoring
jobs.description: Use GIS and remote sensing technologies to monitor environmental changes, analyze spatial patterns, and support conservation efforts. You'll work with satellite imagery, drone data, and field measurements.
requirements: MS in Geography, Environmental Science, or GIS
3+ years experience with ArcGIS, QGIS, and remote sensing
Proficiency in Python, R, and spatial analysis
Experience with Google Earth Engine and cloud computing
Knowledge of environmental monitoring and conservation practices

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow - Climate Modeling
jobs.description: Conduct cutting-edge research on regional climate modeling and climate change impacts. You'll develop and validate high-resolution climate models, analyze model output, and collaborate with international research teams.
requirements: PhD in Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, or related field
Experience with climate models (CESM, WRF, RegCM)
Strong programming skills in Python, Fortran, or C++
Publication record in peer-reviewed journals
Experience with high-performance computing systems

jobs.title: Energy Data Analyst
jobs.description: Analyze energy consumption patterns, grid performance, and renewable energy integration. You'll work with smart meter data, weather data, and energy market information to optimize grid operations.
requirements: BS/MS in Engineering, Data Science, or related field
2+ years experience in energy data analysis
Proficiency in SQL, Python, and data visualization tools
Knowledge of electricity markets and grid operations
Experience with time series analysis and forecasting

jobs.title: Oceanographer - Climate Research
jobs.description: Study ocean-climate interactions, sea level rise, and marine ecosystem responses to climate change. You'll analyze oceanographic data, deploy instruments, and contribute to climate impact assessments.
requirements: PhD in Oceanography, Marine Science, or related field
Experience with oceanographic instruments and data collection
Knowledge of ocean-atmosphere interactions
Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, and oceanographic software
Field work experience and ability to participate in research cruises

jobs.title: Weather Forecasting Meteorologist
jobs.description: Provide weather forecasts and warnings for the southeastern United States. You'll analyze weather data, run forecast models, and communicate weather hazards to the public and emergency management officials.
requirements: BS in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science
National Weather Service certification preferred
Experience with weather forecasting and model interpretation
Strong communication and public speaking skills
Ability to work shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays

jobs.title: Climate Risk Analyst
jobs.description: Assess climate-related risks for insurance and reinsurance portfolios. You'll analyze catastrophe models, evaluate exposure to natural disasters, and develop risk management strategies for extreme weather events.
requirements: MS in Atmospheric Science, Risk Management, or related field
3+ years experience in catastrophe modeling or risk analysis
Proficiency with RMS, AIR, or similar catastrophe modeling platforms
Knowledge of insurance/reinsurance industry practices
Strong analytical and communication skills

jobs.title: Catastrophe Modeler
jobs.description: Develop and validate catastrophe models for natural disasters including hurricanes, earthquakes, and floods. You'll work with historical data, climate projections, and advanced statistical methods to quantify insurance risks.
requirements: PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, or Atmospheric Science
Experience with catastrophe modeling software and methodologies
Strong programming skills in R, Python, or MATLAB
Knowledge of extreme value theory and statistical modeling
Understanding of insurance industry and regulatory requirements

jobs.title: Quantitative Risk Analyst
jobs.description: Develop and implement quantitative models for climate-related financial risk assessment. You'll work with derivatives pricing, portfolio optimization, and regulatory capital calculations for climate stress testing.
requirements: PhD in Mathematics, Physics, or Quantitative Finance
5+ years experience in quantitative finance or risk management
Proficiency in Python, R, C++, and SQL
Knowledge of derivatives pricing and risk models
Experience with climate scenario analysis and stress testing

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Climate Tech
jobs.description: Build and deploy machine learning models for climate prediction, carbon footprint analysis, and renewable energy optimization. You'll work with large-scale climate datasets and cutting-edge ML techniques.
requirements: MS/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field
4+ years experience in machine learning and deep learning
Expertise in TensorFlow, PyTorch, and cloud platforms
Experience with time series forecasting and geospatial data
Knowledge of climate science and environmental applications

jobs.title: Exploration Geophysicist
jobs.description: Lead geophysical surveys for renewable energy site assessment and subsurface characterization. You'll use seismic, gravity, and electromagnetic methods to evaluate geothermal and carbon storage potential.
requirements: MS in Geophysics, Geology, or Earth Sciences
5+ years experience in exploration geophysics
Proficiency with seismic processing software and interpretation
Knowledge of geothermal systems and carbon sequestration
Experience with field data acquisition and QC

jobs.title: Environmental Geologist
jobs.description: Conduct environmental site assessments, groundwater monitoring, and contamination remediation projects. You'll use geological principles to assess environmental risks and design cleanup strategies.
requirements: BS/MS in Geology, Environmental Science, or related field
3+ years experience in environmental consulting
Professional Geologist (PG) license preferred
Knowledge of environmental regulations and remediation techniques
Experience with groundwater modeling and site characterization
